title: Procurement of measuring instruments for Deep Bhavan and Lighthouse Stations under Kolkata Directorate
summary: GeM two-packet bid for supply of electrical and network measuring instruments (insulation testers, earth testers, clamp meters, cable testers, crimping tools, RJ45 connectors) for Deep Bhavan Kolkata and lighthouse stations under the Kolkata Directorate.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Kolkata

sites.name: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, D-372/2, Taratala Road, Kolkata-700088

scope.item: Analog Type Hand Held Megger / Insulation Tester, CIE or Reputed Make
Analog Type Hand Held Earth Tester, CIE or Reputed Make
Digital Type Hand Held Clamp Meter, Metravi (Fluke/Metravi in GeM listing) or Reputed Make
Digital Cable Network Tester, Reputed Make
RJ45/RJ42 Port crimping tools, Reputed Make
RJ45 CAT6 I/O Port Connector, Reputed Make

money.notes: Estimated bid value Rs 3,54,894 including GST. GeM bid page says EMD not required and ePBG not required, but buyer ATC demands EMD of Rs 7,100 by DD/FDR/BG or bid security declaration for MSME bidders. MSE purchase preference: L1+15%, up to 25% of quantity. MII purchase preference: No.

eligibility: GeM: minimum average annual turnover of bidder (3 years) Rs 1 lakh; OEM average turnover Rs 1 lakh; 3 years past experience; past performance 50%; MSE and startup relaxation for experience and turnover
ATC mandatory: EMD Rs 7,100 or bid security declaration (MSME), PAN, GST, compliance sheet (Annexure-I), bid acceptance letter, non-blacklisting affidavit (2026)

ATC scored criteria: average annual turnover min Rs 2 lakh (15 marks); ITRs 2023-24 to 2025-26 (15); bank solvency certificate min 40% of estimate in 2026 (10); similar work experience in last seven years - one work >= Rs 2,83,915, or two >= Rs 1,77,447, or three >= Rs 1,41,960 (30); performance of works (30)
Similar work: supply of measuring instruments
Must score 100% in mandatory requirements, at least 50% each in attributes 2-4 and 70% overall to qualify
specs: Insulation tester: hand driven, 0.01 MOhm to 10 GOhm, accuracy 8%, resolution 0.01 MOhm, test voltage 2500 V, test current 1 mA, CAT III 600 V IEC 61010, calibration certificate, 1 year warranty
Earth tester: range switch 0-100 Ohm, 4-pole method, earth voltage measurement, calibration certificate, 1 year warranty
Clamp meter: 3.5 digit backlit LCD, true RMS, DC voltage range 1000 V, battery operated, CAT III 600 V IEC 61010-2-D31 (UL, CE, CSA, TUV), test leads, 1 year warranty
Cable network tester: RJ45, LED display, 1 year warranty
Crimping tool: hand crimping tool for RJ45, 1 year warranty
RJ45 CAT6 connector: male shielded metal Cat6 plugs, 1.0-4.9 Gbps, packs of 100 pcs
GeM option clause: quantity may be varied +/-25%
notes: Scanned document: GeM bid document (pages 1-9) plus buyer ATC dated 19.08.2026, BOQ and Annexures I-V. GeM says EMD not required while ATC requires Rs 7,100 EMD. Annexure numbering inconsistent within ATC (affidavit referred to as Annexure-II and Annexure-IV). Consignee is a named individual officer (name omitted); buyer e-mail listed on GeM page is [personal contact removed]; HOD e-mail dte-kol@gov.in.
